- heading "[Hiring] Freelance Copywriter @Coalition Technologies" [level=1]
- paragraph: "Oct 02, 2026 - Coalition Technologies is hiring a remote Freelance Copywriter. 💸 Salary: $20k -$35k. 📍Location: Worldwide."
- paragraph: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.
- paragraph
- paragraph: The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.
- paragraph
- strong: About the Role
- paragraph: "Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:"
- list:
  - listitem: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  - listitem: Skincare and beauty
  - listitem: Tech and software
  - listitem: Finance and investing
  - listitem: Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  - listitem: Education
  - listitem: Home improvement
  - listitem: Automobiles and motorcycles
  - listitem: Health and wellness
  - listitem: Medical and clinical fields
  - listitem: Digital marketing
  - listitem: SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing
- paragraph: Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.
- strong: Responsibilities
- list:
  - listitem: Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  - listitem: Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  - listitem: Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  - listitem: Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  - listitem: Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  - listitem: Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team
- strong: Qualifications
- list:
  - listitem: Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  - listitem: 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  - listitem: Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  - listitem: Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  - listitem: Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  - listitem: Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  - listitem: Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred
- strong: Compensation
- paragraph: Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.
- paragraph: Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate
- paragraph: This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page
- paragraph: After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate
- paragraph: After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate
- paragraph
- strong: Application Process
- paragraph: Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.
- text: About The Company
- link "Coalition Technologies" [e7]:
  - /url: https://remotive.com/remote-companies/coalition-technologies-35560
- text: A Leading Web Design & SEO Company
- paragraph:
  - strong
- paragraph:
  - strong: Our SEO, web design, PPC, social, and email strategies are based on hard data and scientifically-tested techniques.
- paragraph:
  - strong
- paragraph:
  - strong: Watch out for web design companies who have read a few blog posts about digital marketing, know buzzwords like “SEO” and “PPC”, and think they can provide these services. Watch out for any agency that doesn’t have many strong examples of their work, such as our case study portfolio.
- paragraph:
  - strong
- paragraph:
  - strong: We only hire the top 1% of our skills-tested applicants, and their rigorous training includes our university-level educational courses. We have advanced systems and AI-powered tools to make sure our work is of the highest quality.
- paragraph
- paragraph:
  - strong: Our team members benefit from extraordinary incentives, including the ability to grow their pay several times over by delivering outstanding results for our clients.
